title: Even more batteries included with Emacs
summary: This article explores Emacs's extensive built-in features that users often overlook, demonstrating how the editor comes with powerful packages for tasks like file management, text manipulation, and workflow automation without requiring third-party plugins.
problem_solved: Addresses the common problem of Emacs users not knowing about built-in functionality, leading to unnecessary third-party package installations.
why_valuable: Helps users maximize productivity by leveraging Emacs's native capabilities, reducing configuration burden and dependency on external packages.
